cls.belfry.desc: Bell-bearer: tanky, area strikes, returns punishment. Toll rises when hitting and being hit; at 80 it enters Resonance.
cls.belfry.name: Belfry
cls.prismatist.desc: Prisms and beams: area control and sustained damage. Fulgor rises with casting; at 100 it overflows into Dazzle.
cls.prismatist.name: Prismatist
cls.skirmisher.desc: Mobility, bursts and bleed. Its Rhythm grows by moving, dodging and striking; each charge speeds you up.
cls.skirmisher.name: Skirmisher
dfm.broken_facility.desc: Serrane workshops with bulkheads, turrets and loose strings. Constructs that still follow orders.
dfm.broken_facility.name: Broken Facility
dfm.crystal_cavern.desc: Irregular caves where crystal amplifies sound. Discordant fauna and ambushes.
dfm.crystal_cavern.name: Crystal Cavern
dfm.serrane_crypt.desc: Pillars, sarcophagi and tone puzzles. Hollows guard what they no longer remember.
dfm.serrane_crypt.name: Serrane Crypt
enm.brass_sentinel.desc: Heavy construct: hits hard and slow. Dodge the stomp.
enm.brass_sentinel.lore: It follows a guard order no one remembers giving.
enm.brass_sentinel.name: Brass Sentinel
enm.chime_spitter.desc: Artillery: lobs acid globs from afar. Flank it.
enm.chime_spitter.lore: It swallows ground bronze and spits it back as poison.
enm.chime_spitter.name: Chime Spitter
enm.cliff_stalker.desc: Fast predator that flanks and pounces. Bites and withdraws.
enm.cliff_stalker.lore: It used to hunt Serrane goats. Now it hunts the sound of your steps.
enm.cliff_stalker.name: Cliff Stalker
enm.cracked_cantor.desc: Throws notes from behind the line. Interrupt it.
enm.cracked_cantor.lore: His voice split into two tones; he sings both at once.
enm.cracked_cantor.name: Cracked Cantor
enm.crackhide_boar.desc: Charges in a straight line and stuns itself against rock.
enm.crackhide_boar.lore: Its hide cracked when the Choir fell silent; it hurts it more than you.
enm.crackhide_boar.name: Crackhide Boar
enm.drone_swarm.desc: Small and fast: one area hit clears them.
enm.drone_swarm.lore: Brass insects that once pollinated bell gardens.
enm.drone_swarm.name: Drone Swarm
enm.echo_burrower.desc: Hides underground: Listening reveals it before it ambushes.
enm.echo_burrower.lore: It follows footstep echoes beneath the hollow floor of the Terrace.
enm.echo_burrower.name: Echo Burrower
enm.hollow_chorister.desc: Basic melee. Walks in time: use its rhythm.
enm.hollow_chorister.lore: It repeats a phrase from its last rehearsal. Always the same.
enm.hollow_chorister.name: Hollow Chorister
enm.hollow_sacristan.desc: Heals and rouses allies. Kill it first or the fight drags on.
enm.hollow_sacristan.lore: He tends things that no longer exist with impeccable devotion.
enm.hollow_sacristan.name: Hollow Sacristan
enm.hollow_shieldbearer.desc: Its frontal shield absorbs almost everything; flank it or use sound.
enm.hollow_shieldbearer.lore: It guarded the choir. Now it guards the void it left.
enm.hollow_shieldbearer.name: Hollow Shieldbearer
enm.hollow_whisperer.desc: Assassin: appears behind you after a whisper. Heed the warning.
enm.hollow_whisperer.lore: It whispers your name. It is not yours, but nearly.
enm.hollow_whisperer.name: Hollow Whisperer
enm.keening_wisp.desc: Floats, wails and silences. Its keening gives away its position.
enm.keening_wisp.lore: They say they are the notes the Choristers never got to sing.
enm.keening_wisp.name: Keening Wisp
enm.mute_bellringer.desc: Its clapperless bell strikes in waves; it makes no sound, but it hurts.
enm.mute_bellringer.lore: He rings a bell no one hears, and all Hollows obey.
enm.mute_bellringer.name: Mute Bellringer
enm.penitent_blast.desc: Runs at you and bursts. Shoot it from afar.
enm.penitent_blast.lore: It offered to fall silent forever. It only knows how to do it loudly.
enm.penitent_blast.name: Explosive Penitent
enm.pulsing_cocoon.desc: Heals allies and rouses them. Always the first target.
enm.pulsing_cocoon.lore: No one has seen what comes out of a cocoon. No one has seen one open.
enm.pulsing_cocoon.name: Pulsing Cocoon
enm.reaper_gear.desc: Patrols a fixed route, spinning like a blade. Learn the pattern.
enm.reaper_gear.lore: It mowed grass between the Canticles. No one told it the harvest ended.
enm.reaper_gear.name: Gear Reaper
enm.tuning_turret.desc: Fires line beams. Disabled by sound.
enm.tuning_turret.lore: It tunes the air with gunfire. It still thinks there is an instrument to serve.
enm.tuning_turret.name: Tuning Turret
enm.wailer.desc: Summons Hollows and curses. Shows up in large groups.
enm.wailer.lore: She weeps for those who emptied. The more she weeps, the more empty they become.
enm.wailer.name: Wailer
enm.wire_spider.desc: Weaves binding cable traps. Cut the cable or leap.
enm.wire_spider.lore: Built to tighten organ strings. It tightens whatever it finds.
enm.wire_spider.name: Wire Spider
